expectations.evidence: Defines --color-primary, --color-secondary, --color-surface etc. in ThemeTokens interface and LIGHT_THEME/DARK_THEME constants. Components consume via var(--color-*).
Explicitly avoids ::ng-deep. States it is deprecated and explains the alternative.
Uses Renderer2 + effect() to set inline CSS custom properties on host element. Also provides data-theme attribute alternative.
Uses default ViewEncapsulation.Emulated. Explains how CSS custom properties are unaffected by Angular's attribute rewriting.
DashboardComponent uses var(--color-surface-variant), var(--color-outline), var(--color-on-surface). CardComponent uses var(--color-surface), var(--color-primary).
